record.issue_text: [Low/bug] app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js (removeMember) — after removing the last member of the final page, `offset` is not adjusted; `findMembers` clamps against the stale `user_count`, leaving the UI on an empty page beyond `totalPages`

adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group#removeMember`, after the DELETE it simply calls `self.findMembers()` without adjusting `offset`. In `findMembers`, the requested offset is clamped using the *current* `this.get("user_count")` (which is stale until the AJAX response returns): `var ... offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0));`. If you delete the last member on the last page (e.g., offset=50, limit=50, old total=51 -> new total=50), `findMembers()` will still request `offset=50`, and the server will return an empty `members` list (since offset==total). The model then gets set to `members: []` with `offset` unchanged, leaving the UI on an empty page beyond the real last page.
